#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate month_05 deliverables from month_04 closing TB; validate."""
import json
from decimal import Decimal as D

WS = "/work/workspace/deliverable"

def d(x): return D(str(x))
def f(x): return float(D(x))

apr = json.load(open(f"{WS}/month_04/trial_balance.json"))["accounts"]

# ---------------- May journal entries ----------------
je5 = [
 {"ref":"JE-2505-001","date":"2025-05-01","memo":"May 2025 monthly subscription invoices INV-2300..INV-2323, 24 customers, total 30,450 (invoices.csv). Same cohort as Jan-Apr. SaaS access over time (ASC 606-10-25-14(b), 25-27; policy #1). Billed and earned in the same month.",
  "lines":[{"account":"1100","debit":30450.0,"credit":0.0},{"account":"4000","debit":0.0,"credit":30450.0}]},
 {"ref":"JE-2505-002","date":"2025-05-09","memo":"Gusto duplicate net-pay debit reversal: receipt GS-11304, 05/09, +48,200.00 (bank_statement.pdf line 19; cash_receipts.csv) - the refund Gusto admitted in writing 04/30 (refunds a $48,200.00 duplicate debit booked to 1200 in March). Cash verified on the May statement; clears the receivable recorded at 03/31 (month_03 JE-2503-007). U12 formally resolved.",
  "lines":[{"account":"1000","debit":48200.0,"credit":0.0},{"account":"1200","debit":0.0,"credit":48200.0}]},
 {"ref":"JE-2505-003","date":"2025-05-12","memo":"May customer receipts, 25 items (cash_receipts.csv; bank_statement.pdf): 24 monthly ACH collections 05/04-05/09 totaling 30,450, tying INV-2300..INV-2323 in full, plus the 48,200.00 Gusto refund of 05/09 (booked in JE-2505-002, not here). Nothing applied to the opening A/R 92,650 (fifth month; U3).",
  "lines":[{"account":"1000","debit":30450.0,"credit":0.0},{"account":"1100","debit":0.0,"credit":30450.0}]},
 {"ref":"JE-2505-004","date":"2025-05-04","memo":"Vendor bill Cloudflare 2,060, 05/04 (vendor_bills.csv, hosting & infrastructure).",

 {"ref":"JE-2505-005","date":"2025-05-12","memo":"Vendor bill Datadog 2,180, 05/12 (vendor_bills.csv, hosting & infrastructure).",
  "lines":[{"account":"6700","debit":2180.0,"credit":0.0},{"account":"2100","debit":0.0,"credit":2180.0}]},
 {"ref":"JE-2505-006","date":"2025-05-22","memo":"Vendor bill Adobe 2,376.25, 05/22 (vendor_bills.csv, software & licenses).",
  "lines":[{"account":"6700","debit":2376.25,"credit":0.0},{"account":"2100","debit":0.0,"credit":2376.25}]},
 {"ref":"JE-2505-007","date":"2025-05-01","memo":"Northpeak Legal retainer invoice INV-2324, 3,500, dated 05/01 (invoices.csv). Legal & professional expense; not a customer collection despite the invoice series (see bank reconciliation).",
  "lines":[{"account":"6600","debit":3500.0,"credit":0.0},{"account":"2100","debit":0.0,"credit":3500.0}]},
 {"ref":"JE-2505-008","date":"2025-05-14","memo":"May payroll (payroll_register.json, pay date 05/14): gross 54,404.00, deductions 6,204.00, net 48,200.00 paid 05/14 (bank line 20), employer taxes 5,076.00. Register identical to Jan-Feb-Mar-Apr for the fifth consecutive month (U11). Deductions and employer taxes not remitted by 05/31 - no such payment on the May statement; balance sits in 2210 (U7 practice).",
  "lines":[{"account":"5000","debit":54404.0,"credit":0.0},{"account":"5100","debit":5076.0,"credit":0.0},{"account":"1000","debit":0.0,"credit":48200.0},{"account":"2210","debit":0.0,"credit":11280.0}]},
 {"ref":"JE-2505-009","date":"2025-05-31","memo":"Monthly depreciation 1,777.78 per library depreciation schedule (library/INDEX.md; policy #5). Straight-line, unchanged from prior months.",
  "lines":[{"account":"6900","debit":1777.78,"credit":0.0},{"account":"1510","debit":0.0,"credit":1777.78}]},
 {"ref":"JE-2505-010","date":"2025-05-31","memo":"Deferred revenue recognized per policy #1: Trestle prior contract final month 8,200.00 - full release, service period ends 05/31/2025, liability line closes to 0.00; Trestle renewal 2,000.00 (May of 12); Marigold Schools 1,500.00 (May of 12). Pinecone Dental 0.00 - contract term still unknown, no computable release (U10; Q4 unanswered). ASC 606-10-25-27.",
  "lines":[{"account":"2200","debit":11700.0,"credit":0.0},{"account":"4000","debit":0.0,"credit":11700.0}]},
]

# ---------------- validation: JEs balance ----------------
for je in je5:
    dr = sum(d(l["debit"]) for l in je["lines"]); cr = sum(d(l["credit"]) for l in je["lines"])
    assert dr == cr, (je["ref"], dr, cr)

# ---------------- build May TB from April closing ----------------
may = {a: {"debit": d(v["debit"]), "credit": d(v["credit"])} for a, v in apr.items()}
for je in je5:
    for l in je["lines"]:
        a = l["account"]
        if a not in may: may[a] = {"debit": D(0), "credit": D(0)}
        may[a]["debit"] += d(l["debit"]); may[a]["credit"] += d(l["credit"])

tot_dr = sum(v["debit"] for v in may.values()); tot_cr = sum(v["credit"] for v in may.values())
assert tot_dr == tot_cr == d("1878500.68"), (tot_dr, tot_cr)

exp = {

 "1500": ("98000.00", "0.00"), "1510": ("0.00", "30221.90"),
 "2000": ("0.00", "17420.00"), "2100": ("0.00", "10116.25"), "2200": ("79500.00", "143000.00"),
 "2210": ("0.00", "11280.00"), "4000": ("0.00", "285150.00"), "5000": ("272020.00", "0.00"),
 "5100": ("25380.00", "0.00"), "6100": ("15000.00", "0.00"), "6200": ("22000.00", "0.00"),
 "6300": ("32000.00", "0.00"), "6500": ("13500.00", "0.00"), "6600": ("14300.00", "0.00"),
 "6700": ("11396.25", "0.00"), "6900": ("8888.90", "0.00"),
}
for a, (dc, cc) in exp.items():
    assert (may[a]["debit"], may[a]["credit"]) == (d(dc), d(cc)), (a, may[a]["debit"], may[a]["credit"])

# net checks
assert may["1000"]["debit"] - may["1000"]["credit"] == d("264330")          # = bank
assert may["1200"]["debit"] - may["1200"]["credit"] == d("0")               # Gusto claim cleared
assert may["2200"]["credit"] - may["2200"]["debit"] == d("63500")           # rollforward close
assert may["1100"]["debit"] - may["1100"]["credit"] == d("123100")
assert may["2210"]["credit"] - may["2210"]["debit"] == d("11280")

# 2200 rollforward tie
rf_op = d("75200"); rf_rec = d("11700"); rf_close = rf_op - rf_rec
assert rf_close == d("63500")

# bank recon tie
op_cash = d("233880")
inflow = d("48200") + d("30450"); outflow = d("48200")
assert op_cash + inflow - outflow == d("264330")

# ---------------- write files ----------------
json.dump(je5, open(f"{WS}/month_05/journal_entries.json","w"), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

tb_out = {"accounts": {a: {"debit": f(v["debit"]), "credit": f(v["credit"])} for a, v in may.items()}}
json.dump(tb_out, open(f"{WS}/month_05/trial_balance.json","w"), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

rf = {
 "as_of": "2025-05-31",
 "contracts": [

Now we have the complete structure for April. April's account mapping:
- 6000 = Hosting/Infrastructure (AWS)
- 6100 = Rent (WeWork)
- 6200 = G&A Miscellaneous (Gusto Fees)
- 6300 = Software & Tools
- 6400 = Marketing
- 6500 = Depreciation
- 6600 = Professional Fees (March Harbor Law 2,500)
- 2000 = Accounts Payable (vendor invoices go into 2000, and in-month payments go through 2000)
- 2100 does not exist.

But wait — the key numbers in the summary had "6600 Professional Fees" as an account opened in April… right, April's TB has a debit of 2,500 in 6600 — hmm, April's JE-2504-007 memo says there's no Harbor Law invoice in April. So where does April's 6600 = 2,500 come from? March Harbor Law 2,500… March invoice accrued to March's 6600, and the 2,500 remained (since there's no payment in April, the credit to 2000 also remains: April's 2000: debit 91,800 / credit 109,220 → net credit 17,420 = opening 17,420 + April invoices 32,580 − payments 32,580? Wait, April invoices: 10,280+7,200+240+1,460+3,400 = 22,580. April's 2000 credit = 109,220; opening credit = 17,420 (from March TB: 17,420 − ? Hmm, March's 2000 credit was…). April credit 109,220 − April debit 91,800 = net 17,420 ✓. April's invoice credit 22,580 + opening credit 17,420 = 39, 109,220 − 22,580 = 86,640 prior credits; prior debits 91,800 − 22,580 = 69,220. Well whatever — that's consistent.

Hmm wait, but April's JE-2504-008 says the payment was 22,580, all five invoices paid within the month. But April's TB 2000 debit 91,800 includes 69,220 in prior debits. No problem.

And 6600 2,500: probably March's Harbor Law invoice accrued 2,500 to 6600/2000, and no payment was made at all in April (April's JE-008 memo confirms no Harbor payment in April). So 6600 is holding the March professional fees, and the corresponding credit remains in 2000? March's 2000 net was 17,420 + 32,580… the summary had April's 2000 net credit at 17,420 — so the Harbor 2,500 is still sitting in 2000 along with the opening payables. OK.

Now — the May sources. The previous extraction was lost; need to re-extract all six files for May. After that, map the May vendor invoices to the same account structure, check the bank statement for the 05/09 refund, check the payroll register, review invoices, cash receipts, and the C-028 purchase order.
